_comment: Spec for tools/gen/rig-face.py. brows.visiblePoly encloses her visible right brow (viewer-left, above the green eye), read off a 4x gridded crop; the left brow is its mirror across the perpendicular bisector of the iris centres. moves are px (y down): raised lifts the brow (more at the inner end), drawn pulls the inner end down and in. eyes.states are lid apertures (1 = the plate's open eye).
